text:
Before you spend another rupee on ads, check three things. Most ad money is lost after the click, not before it.

1. Where does the ad send people?
If it's your homepage, you're making them search. Send them to a page about that one service, with the price range and a WhatsApp button.

2. How fast do you reply?
Fill your own form or send your own WhatsApp and time it. If a lead waits hours, part of the ad budget is wasted.

3. Do you know which ad brought the customer?
Without tracking, you can't tell a good campaign from a bad one, so you can't cut the waste.

Fix these first. Then the same budget usually works harder.
